title: About
text: I am a Biotechnology graduate with a keen interest in omics and computational algorithms applicable to biological data. My work brings together large-scale omics data analysis, visualization and quality control to connect computational results with biological insights. With training and experience in Python, R and data visualization, I am interested in automating workflows, ensuring data reliability and contributing to scientific discoveries. I enjoy working both collaboratively and independently.

title: Research
text: Investigating Schwann cells in diabetic neuropathy through transcriptomic analysis in R, identifying regulatory pathways and connecting findings to biological insights. Executed pipelines for quality control, statistical analysis and data visualization using FastQC, R Markdown and ggplot2. Documented analyses to ensure reproducibility and reliability across research projects. Used CESGA high-performance computing resources with Slurm in a Unix-like environment. Contributed results to a bachelor’s dissertation, a congress presentation and two scientific posters. Multi-FASTA split Shell scripting
